t: Will fill without depth limit and repair without formwork. Adheres to damp masonry and is weather-resistant. Easy to shape and can be used on a variety of rough masonry surfaces including cement, concrete, breeze blocks, bricks and stones. Light grey colour when dry. Overcoat 48-72 hours after application with any standard water-based masonry paint or mineral paint. If using polyurethane or epoxy solvent-based paints, first prime with a water-based exterior paint.
b: Easy to Shape & Repair Without Formwork
